name: compareCodeWithStore

versions.rationale: Matches declarations to units by file and name and reports untracked, stale, orphaned and duplicate units.
Skips removed units, so they are never orphaned or matched and an export reappearing under a removed name is untracked (new uid). The orphan message now says to append a `removed` version.

docs: Matches declarations to units by file and name (lineage keeps these current across renames and moves). Only units whose file satisfies `covers` can be orphaned: pass the set of files that were scanned, so units for files outside the scan (or that the parser cannot read yet, like .svelte) are left alone. Removed units are history, not code, so they never match: an export that reappears under a removed unit's name gets a new unit.
